findings.text: The confirmation statement is overdue, with a next due date of 13 September 2026 and a last made up to date of 30 August 2025.
The accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 December 2025 and the next accounts are due 30 September 2027.
The register lists one current person with significant control, F. BLACK, who holds 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights, and the register describes this person as a convicted criminal.
The company has 10 current officers, including 9 directors, and was incorporated on 6 December 2013.
Across the 5 current directors checked, 49 other companies were found: 36 active, 11 dissolved and 2 in liquidation; only the first 5 of 9 current directors were checked.
The company has 11 satisfied charges registered and no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.
Since 24 October 2025, no registered office address changes were filed, and one director, PERSON 644, was appointed on 9 July 2026.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 689 is recorded as active, with no insolvency record, but its confirmation statement is overdue and its beneficial owner is described as a convicted criminal in the register.
